stem: What makes an end-of-shift handoff reconstructable to a qualified person who was not present?
choices: Only a list of completed tasks
A verbal summary with no written record
Only problems that were fully resolved
Completed and incomplete work, key measurements/observations, movements, deviations, holds, unresolved conditions, owners and next priorities
rationale: A handoff must preserve both completed work and open conditions so the next person can reconstruct the operational state.
